title: Three Voyages for the Discovery of a Northwest Passage, volume 2
version: 1844 collected edition; Project Gutenberg full-text transcription
lineage: Full public-domain English transcription of the later collected edition; the account concerns the 1821–1823 voyage, not a date of invention.

passages.note: Account of the Esquimaux of Melville Peninsula and the adjoining islands, medical account: curved wooden screen with a narrow slit for each eye, worn to prevent snow blindness.
Account of the Esquimaux, winter habitations: snow blocks fitted in inward-inclining courses to form a domed dwelling.
